Name: Earthy Inspired Sprites
Author: bigsquishy0
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Earthy Inspired Sprite[/size]
[/b][/center][center][i]A small Content Patcher pack that replaces [b]vanilla NPC sprites[/b] with an earthy, warm palette.
[/i][/center][center]﻿[b]Credits[/b]: Sprites by [b]Poltergeister[/b] and [b]Nonachka[/b]. [/center]
I processed their sheets through a custom [b]Aseprite[/b] palette inspired by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790?tab=files] [b]DaisyNiko’s Earthy Recolor[/b][/url] to unify tones while keeping the original linework.

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*][b]Full NPC coverage[/b] (vanilla townsfolk + a few specials, Bouncer, Dwarf, Governor, Mariner, etc.)
[*][b]SVE NPCs[/b]

[/list]
[b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].
[*]Drop this folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]
[*]Ensure [code]manifest.json[/code], [code]content.json[/code], and an [code]assets/[/code] folder are present.
[*]Launch the game.
[/list]
[b]Config[/b][list]
[*][code]UseBeach[/code]: true/false
[*][code]UseWinter[/code]
: true/false[*][code]UseWinterAsBase[/code]: true/false
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b][list]
[*]Works with map recolors and most content mods.
[*]Conflicts with other packs that edit the same [code]Characters/*[/code] targets; the last loaded wins.
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b][list]
[*]Portraits are not included. Check out the ﻿﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37893][*]Earthy Inspired Nyapu Portraits mod.
[/url][*]Event-only sheets that don’t exist in [code]assets/[/code]
will remain vanilla.[/list]
[b]Credits and permissions[/b][list]
[*]Original sprites: [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿[/b], [b][/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Nonachka][b]Nonachka[/b].[/url]﻿
[*]Palette inspiration: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko’s Earthy Recolor.[/url]
[*]Flashshifter's NPC's﻿
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Content Patcher pack that replaces vanilla NPC walking sprites with a warm, earthy palette. Uses Spring sheets as the base, with Winter and Beach variants when available.

Manifest.Name: Earthy Inspired Sprite
Manifest.Description: Replaces NPC sprites with custom Spring (base), Winter, and Beach sheets.
